verdict.rationale: LocalAI officially ships a Docker image and documents running it with `docker run -p 8080:8080 --name local-ai -ti localai/localai:latest`, providing a straightforward containerized deployment path with the OpenAI-compatible API exposed on a fixed port. Missing for 10: no docs on docker-compose/orchestration examples, persistent volume/model storage guidance, or independent third-party reports confirming reproducibility in production.
